quarterly_data.signal: 10-K manufacturing disclosure: in 2025 TI sourced the majority of its wafer fabrication, as well as assembly and test, internally, selectively using outside foundries and subcontractors to supplement, while qualifying and ramping its newest 300mm wafer fabs in Richardson and Sherman, Texas, and Lehi, Utah, positioned to support customer demand, external foundry transfers and internal transfers from legacy 150mm facilities. Capital expenditures were $4.55 billion in 2025 versus $4.82 billion in 2024 as TI nears the end of its six-year elevated capital expenditures cycle. TI expects direct CHIPS Act funding of up to $1.6 billion for its three large-scale 300mm wafer fabs in Sherman, Texas, and Lehi, Utah, and received $335 million of CHIPS Act incentive proceeds in 2025, including $75 million in direct funding.
quarterly_data.figure: capex $4.55 billion (2025) vs $4.82 billion (2024); CHIPS Act direct funding up to $1.6 billion; $335 million CHIPS Act proceeds in 2025
